primary_target.description: The same automation/task chat reused for setup, hourly execution, and chronological result reporting.
primary_target.delivery_requirement: Post the final report in the same task chat after the repository report is persisted and the lease is released. Do not create a new report chat.

truthfulness_rule: The same task chat may display prior messages, but those messages are not work state or evidence. A report counts as delivered only when it is posted in the current task chat after persistence; GitHub persistence alone is fallback storage, not chat delivery.
